definitions.explanation: A shimmering illusion of water on a hot road or field that recedes as you approach it, caused by heated air bending light near the surface.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{道|みち}に{逃|に}げ{水|みず}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: A road mirage appeared on the summer road.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くの{道路|どうろ}に{逃|に}げ{水|みず}が{光|ひか}っている。
examples.english: A mirage is shimmering on the distant road.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}づいても{逃|に}げ{水|みず}はどんどん{遠|とお}ざかっていく。
examples.english: Even as you approach, the road mirage keeps receding into the distance.

notes:
An optical illusion in which hot air just above a road surface bends light, so a patch of 'water' seems to lie ahead and flee ({逃|に}げる) as one approaches. A common summer sight on paved roads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逃|に}げ{水|みず}が{見|み}える: a road mirage appears
- {逃|に}げ{水|みず}を{追|お}う: to chase a mirage (also figurative: to pursue something unattainable)
